This artwork is my humble expression of devotion, discipline, and detail. Through the medium of ball pen, I explore the idea that even the simplest tools can create something deeply powerful and meaningful. Each stroke in this portrait of Lord Ganesha is intentional—built slowly with patience, reflecting both my artistic journey and my inner connection to the subject.
I am drawn to realism, but I also seek to go beyond mere representation. In this piece, the intricate textures, ornaments, and subtle contrasts are not just visual elements—they are a way of preserving tradition while presenting it through a contemporary lens. The addition of selective color symbolizes life, energy, and cultural richness, while the monochrome detailing grounds the work in precision and control.
Lord Ganesha, as the remover of obstacles and the embodiment of wisdom, represents guidance and beginnings. Creating this piece was not just about capturing his form, but about translating a sense of calm, strength, and spirituality onto paper.
As a self-taught artist, my work is a continuous process of learning, observation, and refinement. Every artwork I create is both a reflection of where I am and a step toward where I aspire to be.
